channel.title: DIY Home Upgrades
channel.description: Small, verified upgrades for the rooms you actually live in.

item.title: New entry: ORDORA 8-tier under-cabinet pots and pans organizer
item.description: Eight adjustable tiers that turn a leaning stack of pans into something you can actually see — sold in eight heights and four finishes.

item.title: New entry: Under-cabinet paper towel holder, matte black aluminium
item.description: A 12.2-inch aluminium rail that mounts under a cabinet either with adhesive or with screws — you choose on installation day, not at checkout.

item.title: New entry: Art3d smoothing tool kit for peel-and-stick wallpaper
item.description: A five-piece starter kit for flat, bubble-free peel-and-stick work — the kind of purchase that costs less than a wasted roll of paper.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing kitchen storage: capacity, cleanup and counter space
item.description: Six questions that separate a storage purchase that fixes a problem from one that relocates it.

item.title: How many tiers do you actually need in a pots and pans organizer?
item.description: Eight tiers sounds like more storage. It is actually more height, and height is the thing your cabinet is already short of.

item.title: Adhesive or screws: how to choose an under-cabinet paper towel holder
item.description: The best paper towel holder is the one that keeps the roll off the counter. The second-best question is how you feel about four holes in a cabinet you do not own.

item.title: Do you actually need a wallpaper tool kit for peel-and-stick?
item.description: Most peel-and-stick jobs fail in the first ten minutes, and almost never because of the paper. They fail because of the tool — or the lack of one.
